objective: Add the code for a hand-run Wear Data Layer round-trip probe between app-phone and app-wear. (1) Add com.google.android.gms:play-services-wearable to gradle/libs.versions.toml (use a current stable version, e.g. 19.0.0; confirm it resolves) and as a dependency of app-phone and app-wear via the catalog alias only. (2) In app-wear/src/debug/ (debug source set ONLY; also a debug-only manifest at app-wear/src/debug/AndroidManifest.xml), add a WearableListenerService that echoes any message received on path /probe/ping back to the sending node on /probe/pong with the same fixed payload, and echoes any DataItem changed at /probe/item back as a DataItem at /probe/item-echo. (3) In app-phone/src/androidTest/kotlin/com/mcfrenchpants/activityledger/wear/WearDataLayerProbeTest.kt add an instrumented measurement test (modelled on the existing PlatformSpeechRecognizerProbeTest in app-phone/src/androidTest/**) that: reads connected nodes via NodeClient and reports only whether a watch is connected (never ids/names); if none, reports 'no watch connected' as a result and passes; otherwise sends /probe/ping via MessageClient and waits (bounded, e.g. 10 s) for /probe/pong; puts a DataItem at /probe/item and waits for /probe/item-echo; prints one structured result line per check via a log tag, containing no user content or device identifiers; registers listeners dynamically and always removes them in finally. Payloads are fixed probe strings. Use kotlinx coroutines play-services await only if an alias exists; otherwise use Tasks with CountDownLatch.
non_goals: No product UI, no changes to MainActivity in either app.
No ML Kit dependency (ADR-023); app-wear must not depend on core-ai.
No INTERNET or ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE permission in either merged manifest (ADR-025); if play-services-wearable adds one, strip it with tools:node=remove and say so.
Echo service must not exist in the release variant.
Do not modify docs/, BACKLOG.md, PROGRESS.md or .sdlc/.
Do not run anything on a device; none is connected.
acceptance_criteria: The echo service and its manifest declaration exist only under app-wear/src/debug; the release merged manifest of app-wear has no such service (verify via processReleaseManifest or equivalent and report).
No literal versions in build files; no com.google.mlkit coordinate added; app-wear has no dependency on core-ai.
Neither merged debug manifest contains INTERNET or ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE (report the check).
The probe test handles 'no watch connected' as a passing reported result and removes all listeners in finally.
No log line contains capture text, node ids or device names (AGENTS.md #11).
